title: Polish authorities find Russian missile remains at three sites following airspace incursion
summary: In the newest announcement, the Lublin District Prosecutor’s Office revealed that debris from Kh-101 cruise missiles was discovered at three sites in eastern Poland: Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik, and Mołodycz.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,639,641 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,471 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Investigation: How Russians with criminal records obtained Romanian passports by posing as Ukrainians
summary: For Russian citizens who have never enjoyed visa-free travel in Europe — and were hit with new visa restrictions after the start of the full-scale invasion — Romanian passports offered a way to evade sanctions and access the privileges of the EU.

title: Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery, Tatarstan pumping station burning after Ukrainian drone attack
summary: The plant is considered one of the important suppliers of petroleum products in southern Russia supplying the Russian armed forces.
